well.title: Ostrel · Village Well
well.brief: Spiral Draw pulls one ally back 2 slots, and every 3rd turn the Well hums the note at everyone. Read who it is about to take, and let Natsu keep the party standing while the others hit. (Uzumaki)

wolf.title: The Border · Rewound Wolf
wolf.brief: The wolf has two slots in the turn order, one alive and one dead. When the wolf falls, the dead slot acts within 1 slot and gets it up again, stronger. A hit on the dead slot pins it until its turn, so pin it first, then kill the wolf before that turn comes. (A Gentle Goodbye)

hen.title: The Chocobo Ranch · Lake Hen
hen.brief: She stays underwater and calls a Wet Chick every turn. Miren's landing splash brings her up until her next turn, but only the others can hit her then, and every chick still alive when she surfaces heals her 10%. Clear the chicks before he lands. (Gyo)

pelt.title: The Cliffside Temple · Last Beastcaller's Pelt
pelt.brief: It is empty and takes no damage. Goku's Summon Hound bites in and holds it open for 2 of its turns, when everyone's hits land, but Goku can't act and the Pelt thrashes at her. Every 4th turn it puts someone on instead. (Frankenstein)

ruri1.title: Port of Vesk · Ruri
ruri1.brief: Miren laughed at her. She Charms whoever is closest to breaking (+12 Stress) and slaps the rest. Soothe the one she is working on before they reach a Stress Check. (Tomie)

lamp.title: Kuro's Street · Lamp Hollow
lamp.brief: The Hollow takes no damage while any Wick is lit, and a Wick that goes out is relit on the next Wick's turn. Darkga can't put out a Wick at full HP, so weaken all three first, then put them out at once: the Hollow is dark for 2 of its turns. (Long Hair in the Attic)

rested.title: The Flooded Ruins · The Well-Rested
rested.brief: Four identical sleepers. Only the original takes damage; hitting a copy splits off another (up to 6). Kiri's Lullaby puts every copy to sleep for 2 of its turns, but the original never sleeps: hit the one still awake. (The Long Dream)

tracks.title: The Calm · Your Own Tracks
tracks.brief: A copy of each of your three, made at the start. Each copy does whatever its original did on their last turn, aimed back at you: hit Natsu's copy and your copy hits Natsu. Choose commands you can stand to have done to you. (The Enigma of Amigara Fault)

forty.title: The Gull of Patience · Forty Years
forty.brief: The Helmsman can't be targeted while the ship is on course. A push on the Hull throws it off course until his next turn, but the deck tilts and everyone not Defending is pushed back 2. Defend, then Delay Shot the Hull, then strike. Every 4th turn Course Correction hits everyone. (The Long Dream)

choir.title: Lumen · Choir of Lumen
choir.brief: Four Choristers. Each Hymn adds more Stress for every other Chorister still singing, and every 4th turn they push the listeners back with Amen. Thin the choir with Darkga and block the big songs with Counter-Melody. (Village of the Sirens)

hound.title: The Earth Crystal · The Grey Hound
hound.brief: Goku fights beside you on her own. The hound can't be KO'd and every hit makes it stronger. When Goku acts with under 50 Stress she calls it back one step, and three steps end the fight, but each of its attacks adds 20 Stress to her (10 if its target Defends and holds it back). Soothe her, and move her turn ahead of its. (Uzumaki)

whisperer.title: The Lumen Archive · The Whisperer
whisperer.brief: She stands behind one of you and can't be targeted while she does. Each turn she whispers that ally's next command, and on their turn they carry it out instead of yours, sometimes an attack on an ally. Swap the whispered ally out: with no one to stand behind, she can be hit until her next turn. At 50% HP she stands behind two. (The Whispering Woman)

ruri5.title: Varn · Ruri ×5
ruri5.brief: Five Ruris, each sure she is the Empress's favourite. They attack each other until half of them are down; then the rest stop fighting each other and turn on you. Spread the damage so they keep fighting. (Tomie)

engine.title: Varn · Resonance Engine Mk. IV
engine.brief: It starts slow. Stomp can Paralyze for 2 turns, and every 3rd turn its Resonance adds Stress to everyone. Below 50% HP its turns come 2 slots sooner: Delay Shot and Break keep it slow. (Gyo)

listeners.title: The Sunken Monastery · The Hundred Listeners
listeners.brief: The Abbot can't be targeted while any of his 3 Lead Listeners stand. A Listener brought to 0 HP is only knocked into its coffin: before the Abbot's next turn, a different ally must seal it by using any item on it. At 50% HP he reopens a sealed coffin every 2nd turn. (Tombs)

mirens.title: The Save Point · The Mirens
mirens.brief: Four copies of Miren share one turn, and answer every time the real Miren acts. Copies in the air can't be targeted, and each copy defeated pushes the real Miren back 2. When only 2 are left they Jump every turn. (Tomie)

ruri8.title: Lumen Square · Ruri ×8
ruri8.brief: Eight Ruris, furious that the world is talking about another girl. They fight each other until half are down, then turn on you together. Darkga keeps the crowd thin and even. (Tomie)

facethief.title: Ostrel · The Face Thief
facethief.brief: Each turn she stares at one of you and steals a feature: −20% stats each, and with all three gone they are KO'd and she heals 25%. A feature comes back when, before her next turn, an ally heals its owner and someone hits her. At 50% HP she takes only Kiri's face, and only Tetsugi's Chakra can give it back. (The Face Burglar)

tongue2.title: The Ear · The Tongue
tongue2.brief: Grab takes whoever has the most Stress out of the turn order: +5 Stress each of its turns, and KO'd after 3. It lets go only after hits from 3 different characters, so Swap someone in for the third taste. Soothe decides who it takes. At 50% HP it takes two. (Hellstar Remina)

congregation.title: The Ruins of Lumen · The Congregation
congregation.brief: It stares at one of you, starting with Natsu, and takes no damage from them; the stare adds 10 Stress a turn. A critical hit or a Limit Break pulls the stare onto whoever landed it. At 50% HP it splits into 3 Faces, each staring at a different one of you. (Hellstar Remina)

taste.title: The Tongue's Surface · Taste of Ostrel
taste.brief: It heals 5% a turn for each of its 4 Sleepers still humming. A hit wakes a Sleeper (no damage, +10 Stress to whoever wakes a villager, once per action), and it drifts back after 2 of the boss's turns, so wake them all close together. At 50% HP Kiri's sleeping body hums them back to sleep every other turn; Counter-Melody stops it. (Uzumaki)

widow.title: Port of Vesk · Tide-Widow
widow.brief: At half HP she enters phase 2 and releases 2 Drowned Sailors, which re-form 3 of her turns after you defeat them. Undertow pushes whoever is about to act back 3 slots. (The Thing That Drifted Ashore)

ruri2.title: Moogle Market · Ruri ×2
ruri2.brief: Two Ruris, each claiming to be the one you killed. They attack each other more as one weakens, and Charm adds 12 Stress to whoever is closest to breaking. (Tomie)

orlen.title: Lumen · Orlen and the Great Organ
orlen.brief: Orlen fills Overdrive as your party gains Stress; when full, he and the Organ attack together with Requiem. Counter-Melody makes him hold his voice, but the Organ will play into it to clear the way. Destroy the Organ and it is rebuilt 4 of his turns later. (Honored Ancestors · The Human Chair)

final.title: The Hellstar · Final battle
final.brief: The Hellstar marks a target with Gaze, then Devours it, but only while its Tongue is attached. Blink on the marked ally makes it look elsewhere. Sever the Tongue to buy time; it regrows. Its Overdrive fills as your party gains Stress. (Uzumaki · Hellstar Remina)

t_kiri.title: Test · Spiral Ringer
t_kiri.brief: It adds 6 Danger every turn, and each Toll adds 14 Stress. High Danger makes Spiral Cut hit harder, and Lullaby clears the Stress. (Uzumaki)

t_natsu.title: Test · Blood Drinker
t_natsu.brief: Heavy hits on one target at a time, each adding 10 Stress. Once it is below 75% HP, Drain hits the ally with the lowest HP% and heals it. Cure and Soothe keep the target alive. (Blood-Slurping Darkness)

t_tetsugi.title: Test · Funeral Dolls
t_tetsugi.brief: Four fast, weak dolls that target the ally with the highest max HP. Counter strikes back, but the first doll it catches goes for someone else while Counter is ready. (A Doll's Hellish Burial)

t_miren.title: Test · Hanging Balloon
t_miren.brief: Every 4th turn, Noose Drop hits the whole party hard. Characters who are airborne from Jump avoid it. (The Hanging Balloons)

t_goku.title: Test · Earthbound Woman
t_goku.brief: Her DEF makes light hits do almost nothing, and she hits 10% harder every turn she takes. Summon Hound breaks through and Howl softens Topple. (The Earthbound)

t_hisui.title: Test · Red Turtleneck
t_hisui.brief: A fast duelist with a 45% crit rate who targets the fastest party member. Every crit on Hisui gives her +10% damage; at +30% it stops attacking her. (Tomio • Red Turtleneck)

t_kuro.title: Test · Record Singers
t_kuro.brief: Five weak singers, each adding 4 Stress to the party every turn. Darkga hits all of them at once. (Used Record)

t_ren.title: Test · Long Dreamer
t_ren.brief: Its damage rises 25% with every turn it takes. Delay Shot keeps it from acting, so it stays weaker, but Breaking it wakes it angry. (The Long Dream)

t_sayo.title: Test · Amigara Wall
t_sayo.brief: After 9 of its turns the party walks into the wall and you lose. Its Calling pushes everyone who hears it back 2 slots. Quick Song gets you more turns first. Counter-Melody turns a Calling into a Beckon that pushes back only whoever acts next. (The Enigma of Amigara Fault)

t_kugai.title: Test · Headless Sculpture
t_kugai.brief: Always targets the ally with the lowest HP%, and after two Chisels Behead hits for massive damage. Provoke delays Behead one turn; then it ignores Provoke, so Cover the weak. (Headless Sculptures)

t_fuyori.title: Test · Grease Father
t_fuyori.brief: You start with no items, it has 80 DEF, and Grease Rain adds 16 Stress to everyone without Earplugs. Mix restocks the bag and Acid lowers its DEF. (Glyceride)

t_shio.title: Test · Star Fragment
t_shio.brief: At 95 Danger, Lost Turns come often. Its Gaze names a target one turn before Devour. Foresee removes Lost Turns, and Blink on the marked ally makes it Gaze at someone else. (Hellstar Remina)

peck.name: Peck
peck.desc: From under the water, at the ally with the lowest HP%.

air.name: Come Up for Air
air.desc: She surfaces until her next turn and can be hit: +10 Stress to each ally. Each Wet Chick alive heals her 10% HP.

thrash.name: Thrash

wear.name: Put On

smoke.name: Lamp Smoke

grope.name: Grope
grope.desc: In the dark, it feels for someone.

relight.name: Relight
relight.desc: Relights one Wick that is out, at full HP, from its own flame: this Wick drops to half its HP.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Damage, and a 10% chance of Sleep: the target loses their next turn unless a hit wakes them first.

snore.name: Snore
snore.desc: +10 Stress to each ally who can hear it.

follow.name: Follow
follow.desc: Repeats its original's last command at the same power, turned back on the party. Its Delay is that command's Delay.

correct.name: Course Correction
correct.desc: The ship heels over: damage to each ally.

route.name: Same Route
route.desc: +12 Stress to the ally closest to a Stress Check. It has always been this route.

crew.name: The Old Crew
crew.desc: +10 Stress to the ally closest to a Stress Check: the crew who flew the route before climb out of the planks.

hymn.name: Hymn

amen.name: Amen

bite.name: Bite

pounce.name: Pounce

ainsel.lore: A flayed figure held together by spiralling bandage-ribbons and red tendrils. Its torso is the root; the ribbons chain downward like vertebrae.

amigara.lore: A rock face pierced by five body-shaped holes. The holes are separate silhouettes behind the rock, so they can stretch, lean and swallow.

organ.lore: A cathedral organ played by pale hands from inside its own case. One eye watches from beneath the keys.

orlen.lore: An archbishop trailed by the heads of the five who held the crozier before him. The ancestors chain from his back like a spine.

widow.lore: A drowned bride grown into a swollen fin-bodied thing. Her body is a tank in three layers: a dark back wall, six drowned figures clipped to her silhouette, and a translucent skin of veins over them.

tongue.lore: A bone-white lip that never closes and a tongue covered in mouths of its own. The tongue is a three-bone chain, so it bends as a wave from root to tip; the mouths open in turn.

neighbour.lore: Something wearing the house next door. It leans out of the window on a long neck, its jaw on a hinge of its own, and beckons you over.

congregation.lore: A crowd that moves as one body under a banner of the girl they are waiting for. Every head is its own bone, so they bob and turn out of step.

facethief.lore: A stitched girl with a blank head. Her eyes, nose and mouth are borrowed, and each is its own bone so she can take them off.

ostrel.lore: A village grown on a tongue. The tongue ripples under the houses, the chimneys breathe a slow spiral, and someone in every house is asleep.

pipes.lore: A sewer wall with four drains. One of them has a face behind the grate and a clawed hand that reaches out across the floor.

puppeteers.lore: Two hooded figures working one marionette from two control bars. Each is a small rig of body, hood, arm and bar.

fourheard.lore: Four heroes cast in bronze: wind, water, fire and earth. Each statue is a full rig on its own plinth, and each one wakes in turn.

lastnote.lore: A spiked shell with one note still living in it. The note is a soft chain: a curl in the mouth of the shell, then the singing head.

pelt.lore: An empty wolf-skin hanging from two hooks. The arms, lower hide and tail swing as pendulums, each a beat behind the one above.

wellrested.lore: A tired traveller and the copy that slept for him. Both are full rigs; the copy runs every motion half a beat behind.

lamp.lore: A street lamp with a sleeping face in the glass. The post is a two-bone chain and the housing swings from its hook like a pendulum.

lakehen.lore: A soaked white hen brooding four chicks on black water. Her neck is a three-bone chain, and her head moves like a bird's: it holds still, then snaps to a new angle.

fortyyears.lore: A wreck still under sail, steered by a helmsman who never let go. The drowned crew push their heads and arms out through the holes in the hull.

listeners.lore: A mummified monk seated on a sealed coffin, one hand cupped to his ear, the other ringing a bell to see who answers. His jaw is hinged, so he can chant.

greyhound.lore: A starved grey dog with a woman's face and a rosary for a collar. Each leg is two bones, the ears flick, and the jaw hangs on its own hinge.

whisperer.lore: A woman leaning in to tell you something, her hand cupped to her mouth. She is drawn in grey, and her whisper is the only bright thing about her.

assessment.images: Enumerated current geometry, color mode and transparency for all 22 installed rig sheets. Same source as previous audit. No new raster defect established; attachment notices do not justify generated replacement art.
assessment.animation: Enumerated all 88 clips and six battle rigs. Existing missing integrations remain B004/B005/B006; normal/slow playback is still blocked. Numeric continuity and parity checks pass.
assessment.skeleton_rigging: All rig bone counts and current mappings reviewed; checker emits 16 known attachment notices. B008 retains its visual-confirmation requirement. No new joint defect claimed.
assessment.enemy_ai: All 45 foe records, 37 encounters, script rules/phases and skill descriptions re-enumerated. Orlen B012 implemented. Ruri invalid Jealousy reproduced at the crowd truce and last-copy boundaries, queued B013. Existing finale/engine dependencies retained.
assessment.lore: All 22 viewer descriptions reviewed alongside current story identities and status/specs. Data is unchanged from the prior audit; PR32 already addresses Well-Rested. No additional substantiated contradiction promoted from visual or authoring ambiguity.

new_defect.setup: cfg.enc=ruri5; five Ruris, hadPair=true, phase=p1; stored Jealousy with original first-rule label; dead copies hp=0/alive=false; RNG .99.
